Element Name: PSA_Nadir_Value Definition: Lowest PSA value recorded after initiation of Lu-177 PSMA therapy, used as the reference point for PCWG3-based progression calculations. Data Type: Float Allowed Values: ≥0 Unit: ng/mL Parent Class: Laboratory Results Subclass: Laboratory Metadata
Element Name: PSA_Nadir_Date Definition: Date on which the PSA nadir was recorded. Data Type: Date Allowed Values: YYYY-MM-DD Parent Class: Laboratory Results Subclass: Laboratory Metadata
Element Name: PSA_Response_50_Confirmed Definition: Indicates whether a confirmed ≥50% decline in PSA from baseline was achieved at any point during Lu-177 PSMA therapy. Confirmation requires a second value at least 3 weeks later. Based on PCWG3 criteria. Data Type: Boolean Allowed Values: Yes, No Parent Class: Outcomes
Element Name: PSA_Response_50_Date Definition: Date on which the ≥50% PSA decline from baseline was first documented (not the confirmation date). Data Type: Date Allowed Values: YYYY-MM-DD Parent Class: Outcomes
Element Name: PSA_Best_Response_Percent Definition: Maximum percentage change in PSA from baseline at any timepoint during therapy. Negative values indicate decline; positive values indicate rise. To be reported using a waterfall plot at the study level per PCWG3 recommendations. Data Type: Float Allowed Values: Any real number (e.g., -100 to +∞) Unit: % Parent Class: Outcomes
Element Name: PSA_Progression_PCWG3 Definition: Indicates whether PSA progression per PCWG3 criteria has been documented: ≥25% increase AND ≥2 ng/mL above nadir (after a prior decline), or ≥25% increase AND ≥2 ng/mL above baseline (if no prior decline beyond 12 weeks), confirmed by a second value ≥3 weeks later. Data Type: Boolean Allowed Values: Yes, No Parent Class: Outcomes
Element Name: PSA_Progression_PCWG3_Date Definition: Date of first PSA value meeting PCWG3 progression criteria (not the confirmation date). Per PCWG3, this date does not necessarily indicate clinical need to discontinue therapy — see Reason_For_Discontinuation_Lu177. Data Type: Date Allowed Values: YYYY-MM-DD Parent Class: Outcomes
Element Name: PSA_Progression_PCWG3_Confirmed_Date Definition: Date of the confirmatory PSA value (≥3 weeks after PSA_Progression_PCWG3_Date) establishing definitive PCWG3 PSA progression. Data Type: Date Allowed Values: YYYY-MM-DD Parent Class: Outcomes
Element Name: PSA_Early_Rise_Pre12w Definition: Indicates whether an early PSA rise occurred within the first 12 weeks of therapy without meeting criteria for true progression. Such early rises should not be used to determine PSA response per PCWG3, as antitumor effects including PSA flare may be delayed. Data Type: Boolean Allowed Values: Yes, No Parent Class: Outcomes
Element Name: PSA_Progression_Criteria_Used Definition: Specifies the PSA progression criteria applied for this patient or study, to enable harmonization across datasets with different conventions. Data Type: Coded Value Allowed Values:
1 = PCWG3 standard (≥25% and ≥2 ng/mL above nadir, confirmed ≥3 weeks)
2 = PCWG3 modified (12-week minimum evaluation window applied)
3 = RECIP 1.0
4 = Other (specify in Comments)
Parent Class: Outcomes

Imaging_Response_Criteria_Used Definition: Specifies the imaging response/progression criteria applied for this patient or study. Data Type: Coded Value Allowed Values:
1 = PCWG3 / RECIST 1.1
2 = RECIP 1.0 (PSMA-PET specific)
3 = PERCIST
4 = Other (specify in Comments) Parent Class: Outcomes

Element Name: Imaging_Overall_Response Definition: Overall radiographic response assessment across all sites at best response timepoint. Data Type: Coded Value Allowed Values:
CR = Complete Response
PR = Partial Response
